_comment: APPROVED semantic layer v2 (peer-reviewed 2026-09-16). Served only when KNOWLEDGE_V2_DIR is set; the default live pipeline still reads knowledge/. The env gate stays so rollout is controlled, but the rules are signed off.

rationale.why_json: Structured storage enables (a) agent-proposed additions gated by human approval, (b) richer keyword retrieval today, and (c) clean per-rule chunks for a future embeddings/vector-DB pivot. Prose is rendered from JSON at prompt-build time so the LLM still reads natural language.
rationale.generality: Every rule is written to describe generic SAS behavior, independent of any specific proprietary algorithm (e.g. GLSPLN/RBNN). Snippets are clean-room, textbook implementations, not copied from reference code.

topic_file_schema.topic: string  - short id, matches filename stem
keywords: array of retrieval keywords for the whole topic

<rule_id>.title: short human-readable statement of the rule
keywords: retrieval keywords specific to this rule

proc: sas proc names this rule applies to, lowercase
operations: operation tags used by the retriever

rule: prose guidance as an array of lines/bullets
pitfalls: optional array of common mistakes to avoid

code: optional canonical reference code as an array of lines

reference_impl.module: optional path to a full tested implementation under SAS2PY/semantic_layer/reference/
reference_impl.symbol: the class/function in that module that realizes this rule
reference_impl.note: one-line description of what the reference implementation provides beyond the inline snippet

reference_implementations._comment: Full, tested clean-room ports live under SAS2PY/semantic_layer/reference/generic/. The inline `snippet` in each rule is a minimal teaching version; `reference_impl` on a rule points at the production-grade module here.
reference_implementations.SAS2PY/semantic_layer/reference/generic/: SASRandom (legacy RANUNI stream), sas_percent (PERCENTw.d), proc_univariate (Moments/Measures/Location tests/Quantiles/Extremes, PCTLDEF=5), export_xlsx (PROC EXPORT DBMS=XLSX).

GLMSelectStepwise: SBC-based effect-level stepwise (PROC GLMSELECT SELECTION=STEPWISE), PARAM=GLM class coding with aliasing, INCLUDE= forcing, sas_rank singularity detection, and ODS-style SelectionSummary/ParameterEstimates/ANOVA/FitStatistics.

conventions.code_as_lines: Snippet code is stored as an array of strings (one per line) so JSON stays diffable and free of escaped newlines; the renderer joins them with '\n'.
conventions.approval_workflow: Agent-added rules should be inserted with status='proposed' and source='agent-learned'. A human review flips status to 'approved' before the retriever is allowed to serve them.
conventions.retrieval_bridge: When this layer is adopted, a loader will map applies_to.proc / applies_to.operations to rules (replacing the filename map in src/knowledge/retriever.py) and render the matched rules to text.
